website.error: Services / marketplace company; corporate site advertises the iSpecimen Marketplace platform, not a drug or device pipeline.

commercial_product.description: Online marketplace connecting biomedical researchers (industry, academia, government) with healthcare providers (hospitals, labs, biobanks) to source human biospecimens and de-identified patient data for research and drug development.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Services / biospecimen-marketplace company. iSpecimen does not develop drug or device products; it brokers human biospecimen access for third-party researchers. The FY2025 10-K describes only the Marketplace platform and ClinicalTrials.gov returns no trials with iSpecimen as lead sponsor.
